verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair automation question for a password manager, for example scheduled exports, rotation or reports, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party scheduler or recurring-workflow feature. The CLI and personal API key are 'suitable for automated workflows', but these are building blocks a user would have to drive with external scheduling. TOTP codes rotating every 30 seconds is not a user-schedulable job.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
